answers.answer_text: For packable down jackets for travel in Hong Kong, my top pick is the Uniqlo Ultra Light Down, which offers packable down insulation that stuffs into its own pocket. Another good option is the Montbell Plasma 1000. I would avoid the Columbia Arcadia because it is not insulated.
